== Description ==
The '''Motorcycle''' was the original first vehicle spawned from the [[Military Base]], when it was at Level 0. As with other [[units]], it started from the end of the map path and moved towards the entrance of the map. A '''Motorcycle''' spawned at the start of every wave, one for every Level 0 [[Military Base]], then every 65 seconds after if the wave did not end.

The '''Motorcycle''' was replaced by the [[Humvee]] after the MEGA Update.

== Appearance ==
The '''Motorcycle''' was a grey metal bike, with metal-plated wheels. It had a front headlamp. The humanoid had yellow skin, grey torso and dark grey pants.

== Strategy ==
*The '''Motorcycle''' is only useful against [[Normal]]s and [[Speedy|Speedies]].
**Be aware that you do not get any money when the '''Motorcycle''' collides with enemies.
*On two-pathed maps, only one '''Motorcycle''' will spawn per Level 0 [[Military Base]].
**The '''Motorcycle''' will go down a specific path on these maps.
*While the '''Motorcycle''' can collide with [[Hidden]]s, it will be instantly destroyed upon collision.
*The [[Brute]], [[Tank|Tank 1]] and [[Tank 2]] can destroy the '''Motorcycle''' if a ''Rock Throw'' lands on it.

== Trivia ==
*The [[Humvee]] replaced both the '''Motorcycle''' and [[Truck1]] in the MEGA Update.
